board.label: bm1
board.provenance: PCBBenchmarks CC-BY-SA subset board bm1 (Arduino-Mega-like benchmark); dev-repo corpus path datasets/pcbbenchmarks-r1/raw/bm1/bm1.routed.kicad_pcb; upstream license CC-BY-SA (attribution Arduino; see bm1.license.txt in the source corpus)

render.determinism_scope: raster onward byte-deterministic; kicad-cli PDF bytes are run-local provenance (see render-evidence files)

instrument.pipeline: kicad-cli pcb export pdf --mode-single --scale 1 --check-zones --drill-shape-opt 2 [--mirror] -> fitz 40pt compose -> dpi640 rasterize -> row-background board bounds -> +120px crop

zero_write_declarations: dataset tree not written (board rendered from an in-run copy)
kicad-cli .kicad_prl sidecars confined to the run work dir (sidecar listing per view in the render-evidence files)
